name: fry_negate_cannot_counter_it
notes: Printed: 'This spell can't be countered. Fry deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker that's white or blue.' P0 Fries P1's blue 2/2; P1 responds with Negate (counter target noncreature spell). Negate resolves but Fry is not countered: the blue creature takes 5 and dies; both spells end in their owners' graveyards.
